name: append_rate_limit_note
transcript_text:
George: We need to document the new burst allowance in the API docs. The rate limit is 100 per minute normally, but we now allow a burst of up to 200 for the first 10 seconds.
Helen: Add that note to the Rate Limits section in the API docs.

confluence_workspace_pages.title: API Documentation
confluence_workspace_pages.content_html:
Rate Limits

The API allows 100 requests per minute per client.

expected_proposals.new_text: A burst allowance of up to 200 requests is permitted for the first 10 seconds of each minute.
